caption: The drawing is on a textured, irregularly shaped surface with tan and light brown coloring, possibly representing animal hide, and is mounted on a rectangular beige background. At the top edge of the drawing is a row of greenish-brown, vertical, tree-like or plant forms. Below this, three red and brown star-shaped figures with black tips are arranged horizontally across the upper-middle section. A long, undulating snake spans horizontally across the center of the drawing, from the lower left to the upper right, featuring a grayish-brown body with a red central stripe and smaller black markings. The snake’s head, on the right, has details in red, white, and brown. Below the snake, there are two outlined shapes suggesting four-legged animals, drawn in a lighter gray color. The overall composition uses muted colors, mainly shades of brown, tan, red, green, gray, and black.
title: Ceremonial Apron
